name: Agentic Schedule buy
whatItDoes: Buys a fixed USDT amount of one tokenized stock on a fixed frequency. Deterministic: no model, no selling.
steps: Open https://4lpha.tech/deploy/trading (a plain link: nothing is prefilled; the TradFi preset is the default).
Pick the "Schedule buy" mode tile and set the options listed under requirements.settings.
Press Deploy and choose Agentic Wallet (not Altana).
Scan the QR with the Binance App, tap Confirm, then type the 6-character code the App shows.
Fund the Agentic Wallet with the USDT and BNB the page asks for.
Review the Binance checks and press Deploy; the page then opens your agent's public view.

binanceApp: Connected, with Trade all tokens switched on in the Binance App.
Max sign-in duration long enough for the term (choose 7 days if the Binance cap is short).
Daily limit of at least 2 x the capital.

funding.bnb: 0.0004 BNB per transaction slot; slots = 1 + 2 + min(planned buys, buys the term can run); 2 more slots (0.0008 BNB) if you opt in to Earn.

settings: One quoted bStock, a total budget and an amount per buy of at least 5 USDT.
The Deploy form wants the total budget to cover at least one buy plus a 5 % fee reserve.
Frequency: 1 hour, 4 hours, 8 hours, 12 hours, Daily.
First buy: now, or within the next 7 days and before the entry cutoff.
Finish: when the budget is spent, on an end date, or after 1 to 1000 runs.
Buy only while the price is within 0.5 to 1.5 % of NAV (form default 1.5 %); optional: only during US market hours.
requirements.termEnd: Holdings are kept at term end (a Schedule buy never sells).

rules: Use a dedicated Agentic Wallet while the agent runs; deploying records that the wallet is dedicated to this agent.
To stop the agent, sign 4lpha out in the Binance App (or sign in to that wallet anywhere else). That ends the agent for good: it cannot reconnect, and starting again takes a new hire with a new QR.
A local Binance Agentic Wallet (baw) sign-in on a hired wallet ends the agent the same way.
Holdings stay in your wallet when the agent ends or you sign out; sell them in the Binance App.

conditions: Spare USDT goes to Venus or Aave v3 (best rate) until a buy needs it.
Up to 60 % of capital, and only if at least 20 USDT.
Everything comes back 2 hours before the end.
A small BNB fee per move; the protocols are third parties.

authorises: Hiring is a human action in the user's own browser and Binance App. This MCP cannot hire, sign, move funds or place an order; it returns the link and the numbers.
